name: Renkei Forum
description: Renkei Forum — a landing theme for a regional procurement forum or conference. A flat electric-blue title band carries the event name and one ticket button; under it a dark field holds one documentary photograph at the centre, overlapping the band, with ghosted giant words, a thin blue ellipse and gliding sector marquees. Headings sit on solid blue bars, the speakers open under a full-width ellipse and the programme rises out of a dome into stacking session cards, followed by the venue, stories, a price table and FAQ. Schibsted Grotesk for headings, Manrope for reading. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA text colours; the first screen has no entrance animation.
